scope: TRAIN10 ONLY: C2,C3,C4,C5,C6 × layers4,12. No holdout waveform read.

method.frequency: Stereo power sum; Hann window0.1..2.1s after observed onset; interpolated high-resolution FFT peaks; dominant peaks in each broad harmonic band; require>=18dB local prominence and>=-60dB global relative peak, then exclude initialfit residuals>4c ifatleast4partials remain.
method.model: f_n=n f1 sqrt((1+B n²)/(1+B)); A=f1²/(1+B),C=A B. engine_B=C/A; normalized_B=C/(A+C).
method.decay: Per-channel complex heterodyne,polyphase down128,zero-phase4th-order lowpass spanning unison cluster,combined channel power. OLS amplitude-dB slopes in0.2..0.8s and1..3s,excluding estimates<12dB over late-file floor. ExtrapolatedT60 is not measured decay-to-silence.
method.unison: Long-window power spectrum around fundamental,peaks separated by Hann resolution; candidatebeat rates are observations,not identified physical strings.

limitations: Microphone and soundboard radiation affect amplitude estimates.
Unison interference makes short-window decay non-exponential; inspect slopes/R² bypartial.
A stiff-string law cannot exactly explain every recorded partial,especially wound-bass and unresolved polarization components.

unison_observation.interpretation: Multiple components can include unison strings, polarization splitting, leakage or recording artifacts. No individual-string identification is asserted.
